turnaround_reason: Concentrix, the CX/BPO roll-up (SYNNEX spin + Webhelp), has been cut from ~$58 to the low-$20s on fears that generative AI will hollow out its core contact-center outsourcing business; the GAAP net loss is driven largely by Webhelp intangible amortization, while underlying FCF (~$775M TTM) stays strong.
bullish_points: Extremely cheap on cash earnings: forward P/E ~2.2x and large FCF (~$775M) against a ~$1.6B market cap
AI-powered iX Suite contract signings up ~400% YoY — evidence the company can sell AI-augmented services rather than only be disrupted by them
Sell-side consensus still 'Buy' (roughly 7 Buy / 2 Hold); some capital return in place
Revenue is not collapsing — FY26 guide is slightly positive constant-currency growth (~0.25-1.25%) on ~$10B
bearish_points: Genuine secular/existential overhang: AI directly threatens the labor-arbitrage core of BPO; the ~2x multiple prices terminal decline for a reason
Net insider selling of ~5.9M shares over 6 months (one ~6M-share sale) — the opposite of an insider-conviction signal
Heavy leverage: ~$5.5B total debt vs $256M cash and a shrunken equity cushion
Guidance was CUT this year on accelerated client offshoring and pricing pressure; the turnaround is unproven
GAAP unprofitable (-13% net margin); the 'cheap on FCF' case leans on adjusted/cash metrics
catalyst: Q3 FY26 print (quarter ends Aug 31, 2026) showing whether AI/iX Suite growth offsets legacy attrition, plus any evidence leverage is coming down
catalyst_timing: Q3 FY26 earnings late September 2026; FY26 ends Nov 30, 2026
suggested_trade: Small spot starter only, sized for a battleground. This is a deep-value option on AI-transition survival, not a clean turnaround; a full research note already exists in data/research/CNXC.md.
key_risk: AI-driven volume/price deflation accelerates faster than iX Suite can replace it, compressing FCF and forcing the equity to keep de-rating despite the low multiple
would_skip_if: Another guidance cut, continued net insider selling, or FCF deterioration in the Q3 print
